# sonarqube_measures (Data Source)

Reads metric measures of a project, branch or pull request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_measures" "api" {
  component   = "example-api"
  metric_keys = ["coverage", "bugs", "vulnerabilities"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component` (String) Component (project) key.
- `metric_keys` (List of String) Metric keys, e.g. `coverage`, `ncloc`, `new_violations`.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) Branch name; defaults to the main branch. Developer edition or above.
- `pull_request` (String) Pull request ID. Developer edition or above. Conflicts with `branch`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `measures` (Attributes List) Measures in `metric_keys` order. Metrics with no value are omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--measures))
- `values` (Map of String) The same measures keyed by metric, e.g. `values["coverage"]`.

<a id="nestedatt--measures"></a>
### Nested Schema for `measures`

Read-Only:

- `metric` (String) Metric key.
- `value` (String) The value; for new-code (`new_*`) metrics, the new-code period value.
